hook: Your plane window has a tiny hole, and it is there on purpose.
title: That Tiny Hole In Your Plane Window
description:
The small hole near the bottom of an airplane window is called a bleed hole. Windows are made of several panes, and the hole balances pressure between them. It lets the outer pane carry the pressure load, and it helps stop fogging.

#Shorts #Technology #Aviation
